title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term helps prevent overfitting by penalizing large coefficients.

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda
text: Increasing the regularization parameter lambda in ridge regression affects the estimated parameters. Consider how the penalty term impacts the coefficients.

title: Impact on Estimated Parameters
text: As lambda increases, the penalty on the size of the coefficients increases. This typically results in smaller coefficients.
